# Get Numbers From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Detects the numbers in the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getNumbersFrom(text: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getNumbersFrom(text: My favorite number is 42)
~~~~
